# ADO203: unexpected-parameter

A parameter is passed that the template doesn't declare.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Category** | Templates and parameters |
| **Default severity** | error |
| **Enabled by default** | yes |
| **Checked on** | template expansion |

## Description

Azure Pipelines rejects parameters that the template doesn't declare.

## Example

Problem:

```yaml
- template: build.yml
  parameters:
    confg: Release
```

Instead:

```yaml
- template: build.yml
  parameters:
    config: Release
```

## Configuration

Change the severity or turn the rule off in `.adolint.yaml`:

```yaml
rules:
  ADO203: off   # off | info | warning | error
```

Or on the command line: `adolint lint --disable ADO203` or `--enable ADO203`.

Suppress a single finding with a comment on the line before it (or `disable-line` at the end of the line):

```yaml
# adolint:disable-next-line ADO203
```

## Questions and feedback

Questions about ADO203, or a false positive? [Open an issue](https://github.com/danielsada/go-ado-pipelines-lint/issues/new?title=ADO203%3A+) with the YAML that triggered it.
